title: Verify inspection summary
boundary: This verifies the signed summary, not the watch in your hand or a factory endorsement.
historical: Historical inspection. Later changes are outside this recorded scope.
privacy: Full serials, private owners and raw evidence are not public.
emptyBody: A recorded independent pass and released completion are required. Check the reference and try again.
deniedBody: Private fields are restricted. Use the public summary reference only.
pendingBody: The result is uncertain. Retry using the same action reference.
unavailableBody: The current source could not be reached. Retry before relying on this summary.
invalidBody: The issuer or summary could not be verified. Ask the issuer for the original reference.
